Simulation

cxt is trained on simulated data. The following code showes how to simulate the entire training and validation datasets, additional datasets for fine-tuning are subsetted from these through preprocessing scripts.

# base dataset

base_dir=/sietch_colab/kkor/cxt/ts

mkdir -p $base_dir
mkdir -p ${base_dir}/llm
mkdir -p ${base_dir}/stdpopsim/v0.2

python simulation_ts_only.py \
    --num_processes 50 \
    --num_samples 10000 \
    --data_dir $base_dir/base_dataset \
    --scenario constant

# sawtooth
python simulation_ts_only.py \
    --num_processes 30 \
    --num_samples 1000 \
    --data_dir ${base_dir}/ssd \
    --scenario sawtooth

# island demography dataset

python simulation_ts_only.py \
    --num_processes 30 \
    --num_samples 1000 \
    --data_dir ${base_dir}/idd \
    --scenario island \

# auxillary dataset

python simulation_ts_only.py \
    --num_processes 100 \
    --num_samples 125 \
    --data_dir ${base_dir}/llm  \
    --scenario llm_ne_sawtooth   \

python simulation_ts_only.py \
    --num_processes 100 \
    --num_samples 50 \
    --data_dir ${base_dir}/llm  \
    --scenario llm_hard_sweeps   \

python simulation_ts_only.py \
    --num_processes 75 \
    --num_samples 50 \
    --data_dir ${base_dir}/llm \
    --scenario llm_island_3pop   \

python simulation_ts_only.py \
    --num_processes 100 \
    --num_samples 500 \
    --data_dir ${base_dir}/llm  \
    --scenario llm_ne_constant   \
